attempted_claim: Let varphi:R^3->R U {+infty} be even convex with 0<∫e^{-varphi}<+infty and Lvarphi(y)=sup_x(<x,y>-varphi(x)). Prove the exact sharp bound P(varphi):=∫e^{-varphi}∫e^{-Lvarphi} ≥ 64, with equality iff, up to a constant, varphi(x1+x2)=c+||x1||_{K1}+I_{K2}(x2) a.e. for complementary subspaces F1⊕F2=R^3 and Hanner polytopes Ki⊂Fi; in particular via symmetric stochastic localization / needle reduction to the known 1- and 2-dimensional functional bounds.
decisive_failure: Three concrete routes were attempted with reproducible computation: symmetric stochastic localization, needle/bisection reduction, and layer-cake reduction to geometric Mahler. Each fails structurally (evenness loss, Legendre non-factorization, wrong-direction coupling). No counterexample to the bound was found and no original increment emerged; the negative diagnostics do not constitute a result.
